description: Use this when the user asks whether a stock fits a famous investor's style or rules ('would Buffett like X', 'does X pass Graham's rules', 'Lynch checklist for X'). Shows how the company does against seven investors' published rulebooks as applied by invest-like (Warren Buffett, Charlie Munger, Benjamin Graham, Philip Fisher, Peter Lynch, Joel Greenblatt, Terry Smith): a fit from 0 to 100 for each, and, for one named investor, each rule with the company's real value and whether it is met. These are published rules applied by invest-like, never the investor's own opinion of the stock.

investor.description: Show this investor's rules one by one

stock.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. 'NVDA', 'Coca-Cola' or 'SAP.DE'

name: check_rulebook
title: Check a stock against investors' published rules
